text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: (—Dirt or turf. For now, it's fine to let fortune run its course. But...)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(I have to decide someday.
I wonder how everyone else decided? Just by aptitudes?)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "When in doubt! Alright, the best way is to just ask directly☆"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Huh? 'Why the two of us
run on turf'?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Of course! It's a given, right, Dia-chan?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"We promised we'd run the Classic Triple Crown
and the Arima Kinen together!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. And above all else... winning the Classics
is the destiny I was born to fulfill.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: “I see... A 'promise with a best friend' and an 'innate destiny.' That's why you chose turf, huh.”

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(In that case, I want to hear the reverse too.
—The reasons why Umamusume run on dirt.)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Why did you purposely choose a path out of the spotlight?
The one person I truly want to ask is—)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why run on dirt?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. What made you decide
to run on dirt, Tarumae?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: The reason, of course, is that her running style is suited for dirt. But there's actually one more thing. And that is...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"I thought working hard on the dirt
would be a better way to promote my hometown, Tomakomai."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Tomakomai's? Why?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: —You see, Tomakomai is one of the premier port cities in northern Japan. But...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"It's not as famous as Sapporo or Hakodate, right?
More like an unsung hero behind the scenes, I guess."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: I felt like that steady, hardworking nature is just so fitting for the dirt tracks.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Even if I don't stand out now, if I work hard,
someday they'll see me! I'll become famous!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Thinking that was why I chose dirt.
Believing that 'dirt is my way of life'!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: The dirt track is my way of life, huh.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
So Tarumae, you chose it by combining
your aptitudes with the image of your hometown?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. To me, dirt is the very embodiment
of my love for Tomakomai!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I see. Then for me, it's aptitude and feelings.
In other words—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should just think about what I can do
to spread feng shui and help people.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Rickey, feng shui again?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
This is a serious matter, so
maybe you should think about it without bringing feng shui into it?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"What you decide right now might affect your whole future, Rickey.
What do you want to do?"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Hmm, hmmm...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Looks like you're troubled by something, Rickey-chan♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Still, of course you would♪ Choosing between
dirt and turf is a super important decision, after all.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Ah, Falco-san...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(Falco-san. Smart Falcon...
A senior Umamusume with an incredible record on dirt.)

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
(She's an Umamusume idol—an "Umadol," right?
An Umamusume whom Tarumae respects so much...)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I agonized over it quite a bit too~♪
Turf~? Or dirt? Which one should it be~☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Turf really is the main attraction of racing. I just couldn't let go of that feeling.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Um! Falco-san,
why did you choose dirt back then?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: I'm really curious to know what made you decide on that!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Umm, I mean, of course dirt suited me better, but...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: The deciding factor was probably the "dream."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: ...A dream?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah! My dream is—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
To become a top umadol! And to shine
brilliantly right at center stage.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: An Umamusume shining with all her might covered in sand is just as precious as on turf. I want to fulfill my dreams on that dirt.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Thinking that way made me decide on dirt! That's why
I believe having a dream is what truly matters."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
A dream...
Aptitude and... a dream, huh?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
As expected of you, Falco-san.
You said exactly what I was thinking right to the point.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, hope I was able to help a bit.
Think it over, Rickey-chan.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
...and that's what happened, Trainer.
Which got me thinking all over again.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I thought it'd be good to sort out my dreams once more.
Before facing my target race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey's dream.
At first glance it seems simple, but it certainly looks like sorting out all the components would be best.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
My dream. In other words, my ultimate goal,
is "making everyone happy with Feng Shui."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Just as Falco-san can shine on the dirt,
Feng Shui power can also be channeled on dirt tracks.
No, rather—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"It's easier to convey through dirt racing. In that case, even if
it takes time, maybe it's better to let it gradually spread through dirt."

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, it should be fine... That way is closer to the dream.
But something is...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I feel like a crucial piece is missing.
Like a dragon vein somewhere isn't connected...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After talking it through, the general picture became clear, but Copano Rickey still seemed a little unsatisfied.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, what is it...?
What's bothering me...?
The key must be somewhere...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's a limit to what thinking can solve.
In a situation like this—
choice_data_list: The 'Fukuryu S' is there to figure that out, isn't it?
The 'Fukuryu S' is there to figure that out, right?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right...
We decided to enter a Dirt Open race
to see how things go.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Trainer.
Looks like I was just overthinking things.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All right, what matters is the "dream."
Got that part! Now all that's left is—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: I'll ask the Hidden Dragon! Let's see what kind of answer the dragon lurking beneath the sand comes up with.
